_note: Prompts for every generated lesson image. `node tools/make-images.mjs` turns these into assets/img/<id>.jpg and records provenance in assets/img/credits.json. Styles: photo (a real thing he should be able to recognise), render3d (the short-3D-explainer look, for what no photograph exists of), meme (a textless visual joke), diagramish (flat vector). Keep every prompt specific and Filipino where the subject is: a generic stock salad teaches nothing.

mapeh-t2w8-go-foods.prompt: A flat-lay of Filipino GO foods, the energy group, arranged on a pale neutral surface: a white bowl of steamed rice, a basket of pandesal rolls, a whole purple-skinned kamote with two slices cut to show the orange flesh, a length of cassava root, and a few pieces of boiled saba banana.
mapeh-t2w8-go-foods.alt: Steamed rice, pandesal, kamote, cassava and boiled saba banana arranged on a pale surface

mapeh-t2w8-grow-foods.prompt: A flat-lay of Filipino GROW foods, the body-building group, arranged on a pale neutral surface: a whole raw bangus milkfish, two boiled eggs with one cut in half, a small bowl of dried monggo beans, a piece of raw chicken, a block of tofu, and a glass of milk.
mapeh-t2w8-grow-foods.alt: A whole bangus, boiled eggs, monggo beans, chicken, tofu and a glass of milk arranged on a pale surface

mapeh-t2w8-glow-foods.prompt: A flat-lay of Filipino GLOW foods, the vitamins and minerals group, arranged on a pale neutral surface: a bundle of kangkong water spinach, a halved ripe papaya showing orange flesh and black seeds, two ripe mangoes, a bitter gourd ampalaya, a bunch of pechay, and several calamansi limes.
mapeh-t2w8-glow-foods.alt: Kangkong, halved papaya, mangoes, ampalaya, pechay and calamansi arranged on a pale surface

mapeh-t2w2-gongs.prompt: Close view of a row of eight small bronze gongs of graded size resting on a carved wooden frame, with two padded wooden beater sticks laid across them, and one larger flat bronze gong propped behind. Warm indoor daylight, pale background.
mapeh-t2w2-gongs.alt: Eight graded bronze gongs on a carved wooden frame with two padded beaters, and a larger flat gong behind

mapeh-t2w3-formats.prompt: A flat-lay showing how recorded music has been stored, left to right on a pale neutral surface: a black vinyl record, a cassette tape, a compact disc catching a faint rainbow sheen, and a modern smartphone lying face down with white earphones coiled beside it.
mapeh-t2w3-formats.alt: A vinyl record, a cassette tape, a compact disc and a smartphone with earphones laid out in a row

mapeh-t2w4-art-tools.prompt: A flat-lay of art-making tools from different eras on a pale neutral surface, left to right: a lump of raw red ochre pigment beside a rough stone hand tool, a wooden-handled bristle brush beside two squeezed tubes of oil paint, and a slim black stylus resting on the corner of a graphics tablet.
mapeh-t2w4-art-tools.alt: Raw ochre pigment and a stone tool, a bristle brush with oil paints, and a stylus on a graphics tablet

mapeh-t2w5-symbols.prompt: A flat-lay of Filipino craft objects on a pale neutral surface: a folded length of handwoven abaca cloth in deep red, black and cream with geometric patterning, a star-shaped capiz-shell lantern, a panel of dark hardwood carved with flowing leaf-and-vine scrollwork, and a small carved standing wooden figure.
mapeh-t2w5-symbols.alt: Handwoven red, black and cream abaca cloth, a star-shaped capiz lantern, a carved leaf-and-vine wood panel and a small carved wooden figure

mapeh-t2w6-panels.prompt: An open sketchbook on a wooden desk, the right-hand page ruled by hand into four empty rectangular comic panels with clean white gutters between them. A mechanical pencil and a kneaded eraser rest beside it. The panels are completely blank. Overhead daylight.
mapeh-t2w6-panels.alt: An open sketchbook ruled into four empty comic panels with a pencil and eraser beside it

mapeh-t2w7-games.prompt: A flat-lay of the everyday objects Filipino street games are played with, on worn pale concrete: a single rubber tsinelas slipper, an empty tin can lying on its side, a woven rattan sipa ball, a stick of white chalk, a handful of small glass marbles, and a long carved wooden sungka board with cowrie shells in its hollows.

mapeh-t2w9-fitness-tests.alt: A wooden sit-and-reach box, a stopwatch, a skipping rope, a tape measure and worn training shoes on a gym floor

mapeh-t2w10-planning.prompt: A flat-lay of a video project being planned on a wooden desk: a row of blank white index cards laid out in sequence, a pencil, a pair of over-ear headphones, and a smartphone resting on a small desktop tripod. The cards are completely blank.
mapeh-t2w10-planning.alt: Blank index cards laid out in a row with a pencil, headphones and a phone on a small tripod

mapeh-t2w11-expo.prompt: A simple school exhibition table seen from a visitor's side: a folding table covered with a plain cloth, holding a small handwoven basket, a star-shaped capiz lantern, a pair of bronze gongs and a tablet propped on a stand with a blank dark screen. Bright hall daylight, no people, no signage.
mapeh-t2w11-expo.alt: A cloth-covered exhibition table holding a woven basket, a capiz lantern, two bronze gongs and a tablet on a stand

tle-t2w1-knives.prompt: A flat-lay of basic kitchen tools on a pale wooden board: a large chef's knife with a curved blade, a small paring knife, a nested set of metal measuring cups and spoons, a stainless steel colander, a pair of kitchen tongs, and an instant-read probe thermometer. Clean and well used, not new.
tle-t2w1-knives.alt: A chef's knife, a paring knife, measuring cups and spoons, a colander, tongs and a probe thermometer

tle-t2w2-station.prompt: A prepared kitchen workstation seen from directly above: a large wooden chopping board centred on a counter with a folded damp cloth just visible underneath it, a chef's knife resting to the right of the board with the blade pointing away, a small bowl for scraps to the left, and a shallow metal tray of already-cut vegetables above. Nothing else on the counter.
tle-t2w2-station.alt: A chopping board centred on a counter with a knife to the right, a scrap bowl to the left and a tray of cut vegetables above

tle-t2w3-fridge.prompt: The inside of a clean domestic refrigerator with the door open, seen straight on. Raw chicken sealed in a clear lidded container sits alone on the lowest shelf. Cooked food in covered containers, a carton of milk and a bowl of vegetables sit on the shelves above it. A small round fridge thermometer hangs at the front. Cool even light.
tle-t2w3-fridge.alt: An open fridge with raw chicken sealed on the bottom shelf and cooked food and vegetables on the shelves above

tle-t2w3-rice.prompt: A wide shallow metal tray of freshly cooked white rice spread out in a thin even layer to cool quickly, steam just visible rising from it, sitting on a kitchen counter beside a closed storage container with its lid off and ready.
tle-t2w3-rice.alt: Cooked rice spread thin in a shallow tray to cool fast, beside an open storage container

tle-t2w4-pantry.prompt: A tidy pantry shelf seen straight on: identical tins lined up front to back, clear sealed jars of rice and flour with small handwritten-looking blank labels, a bottle of cooking oil standing in shadow at the back of the shelf, and a few glass containers. tle-t2w4-pantry.alt: A pantry shelf with tins lined front to back, sealed clear jars of rice and flour, and oil kept at the back

tle-t2w5-cuts.prompt: A wooden chopping board seen from above, holding five neat separate piles of prepared vegetables: thin even slices of carrot, small equal cubes of carrot, fine matchsticks of carrot, a small mound of very finely minced garlic, and a loose pile of fine green ribbons of shredded leaves. tle-t2w5-cuts.alt: Five piles on a board: carrot slices, cubes, matchsticks, minced garlic and fine green leaf ribbons

tle-t2w6-nocook.prompt: A packed no-cook lunch seen from above on a pale surface: a sandwich cut in half showing spread carried right out to the crust edges, a small sealed container of sliced mango and papaya, two boiled eggs, and a cool pack beside an insulated lunch bag.
tle-t2w6-nocook.alt: A halved sandwich with spread to the crusts, a container of cut fruit, two boiled eggs and a cool pack

tle-t2w7-pans.prompt: Two pans side by side on a stove, seen from above. Left: a pan of oil with pieces of chicken browning to a deep golden crust. tle-t2w7-pans.alt: Chicken browning deep gold in oil beside the same chicken simmering pale in water

tle-t2w8-laundry.prompt: Close view of a clothing care label sewn into the inside seam of a cotton shirt, showing a row of small black laundry symbols: a tub of water, a triangle, a square, and an iron. tle-t2w8-laundry.alt: A sewn-in clothing care label showing tub, triangle, square and iron pictograms

tle-t2w9-stitches.prompt: A piece of pale cream fabric in a wooden embroidery hoop, worked with four separate rows of hand stitching in dark thread for comparison: a row of evenly spaced running stitch, a row of solid continuous backstitch, a row of long loose basting stitch, and a row of slanted overcast stitch along a cut edge. tle-t2w9-stitches.alt: Four rows of hand stitching on hooped fabric: running, backstitch, long basting and overcast along an edge

tle-t2w10-hooks.prompt: A simple home drop zone by a front door: a row of three wooden wall hooks at child height holding a school bag and a cap, a shallow woven basket on the floor beneath them, and a small shelf above with a set of keys in a dish. Plain wall, warm daylight, nothing cluttered.
tle-t2w10-hooks.alt: Three wall hooks at child height with a bag and cap, a basket beneath and a key dish on a small shelf

tle-t2w11-mise.prompt: A workstation fully set up before any cooking starts, seen from above: every ingredient already measured into its own small glass bowl and arranged in a neat arc, a chopping board wiped clean, a knife laid parallel to the counter edge, and an unlit stove with a cold empty pan on it.
tle-t2w11-mise.alt: Ingredients pre-measured into small bowls arranged in an arc beside a clean board, a knife and a cold pan

sci-t2w1-three-glasses.prompt: Three identical clear drinking glasses side by side on a pale surface, lit from behind. Left: water with sand in it, the grains clearly visible and settling. sci-t2w1-tyndall.prompt: A darkened room with a narrow beam of light shining horizontally through two clear glass tanks side by side. In the left tank of plain water the beam is invisible. sci-t2w2-settled.prompt: A tall clear glass jar of muddy river water that has been left to stand, photographed straight on against a pale background. A thick layer of brown sediment has settled into a sharp flat band at the bottom and the water above it has gone almost clear.
sci-t2w2-settled.alt: A jar of muddy water left to stand, with brown sediment settled in a flat band and clear water above

sci-t2w3-winnow.prompt: A wide flat round woven rattan winnowing tray held at an angle, with unhusked rice grains in it and a cloud of light chaff blowing off the far edge in the breeze. The heavy grain stays in the tray. Outdoors, warm daylight, hands visible but no face.
sci-t2w3-winnow.alt: Rice being winnowed on a round woven tray, light chaff blowing off the edge while the grain stays

sci-t2w3-magnet.prompt: A strong bar magnet held just above a shallow dish of pale sand, with dark iron filings leaping up and clinging to the magnet in bristling spikes while the sand stays in the dish. Plain pale background.
sci-t2w3-magnet.alt: A bar magnet lifting dark iron filings in spikes out of a dish of pale sand

sci-t2w4-saltpan.prompt: A wide shallow stainless steel pan photographed from above, completely dry, with a crust of white salt crystals left across the bottom in a ring pattern where the water evaporated away. Warm overhead light showing the crystal texture.
sci-t2w4-saltpan.alt: A dry pan with a ring-shaped crust of white salt crystals left where the water evaporated

sci-t2w4-distill.alt: A distillation apparatus: a flask of dark liquid, a sloping condenser, and clear liquid dripping into a beaker

sci-t2w5-tyres.prompt: Two car tyres standing side by side on wet tarmac, photographed from the side at tread level. The left tyre has deep sharp tread grooves. The right tyre is worn almost smooth with the grooves nearly gone. Water is visible on the ground beneath both.
sci-t2w5-tyres.alt: A deeply treaded tyre beside a worn almost smooth tyre, both on wet tarmac

sci-t2w6-wing.prompt: The large rear wing of a racing car photographed close and from behind at track level, showing the steeply angled aerofoil blades and their end plates. Blurred track and kerbing behind. No sponsor markings, no text, no numbers anywhere.
sci-t2w6-wing.alt: The steeply angled rear wing of a racing car seen close from behind

sci-t2w7-ramp.prompt: A skateboard balanced motionless right at the very top lip of a concrete skate ramp, seen from the side, with the curved drop of the ramp falling away below it. Nobody is on it. Late afternoon light, long shadow.
sci-t2w7-ramp.alt: A skateboard balanced at the top lip of a concrete ramp with the drop falling away below

sci-t2w8-drumskin.prompt: Close overhead view of a drum head with a scatter of white rice grains on it, caught mid-bounce a few millimetres above the skin as the drum is struck. The grains are clearly in the air. Shallow depth of field, dark background.
sci-t2w8-drumskin.alt: Rice grains caught bouncing in the air above a drum head as it is struck

sci-t2w8-prism.prompt: A clear triangular glass prism on a white surface in a darkened room, with a narrow beam of white light entering one face and a bright spread spectrum of red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet fanning out of the other onto the surface.
sci-t2w8-prism.alt: A glass prism splitting a narrow white beam into a fanned spectrum of colours

sci-t2w9-teardown.prompt: An electric desk fan taken apart on a workbench and laid out: the removed wire guard, the plastic blade, the motor housing opened to show copper windings, a silver cylindrical capacitor, and the power cord, all arranged in a row with a screwdriver beside them.
sci-t2w9-teardown.alt: A disassembled desk fan laid out: guard, blade, motor with copper windings, a capacitor, cord and screwdriver

sci-t2w10-machines.prompt: A flat-lay of six simple machines on a pale workbench: a steel crowbar, a small rope pulley block, a short wooden ramp, a wheel on an axle, a metal splitting wedge, and a large screw. Arranged with space between them.
sci-t2w10-machines.alt: A crowbar, a pulley block, a wooden ramp, a wheel and axle, a wedge and a large screw laid out on a bench

sci-t2w11-bench.prompt: A school science bench set up for practical work, seen from above: a funnel with filter paper in a flask, a magnet beside a dish of sand, a beaker of cloudy liquid, a small pulley, a ramp with a toy car at the top of it, and a thermometer.
sci-t2w11-bench.alt: A school science bench with a filter funnel, a magnet and sand, a beaker, a pulley, a ramp with a toy car, and a thermometer

math-t2w1-hundred-bar.prompt: A large rectangular bar of dark chocolate divided into a grid of exactly one hundred small equal squares, lying on a pale surface. math-t2w1-hundred-bar.alt: A chocolate bar scored into one hundred equal squares with twenty-five broken off and set beside it

math-t2w2-tiles.prompt: A section of wall tiled in a perfect ten-by-ten grid of small square ceramic tiles, photographed straight on. Most tiles are plain cream. Exactly twenty of them, grouped together in two full columns at one side, are a deep terracotta colour. Even daylight.
math-t2w2-tiles.alt: A ten-by-ten grid of cream wall tiles with two full columns, twenty tiles, in deep terracotta

math-t2w2-coins.prompt: A neat stack of ten identical plain metal coins on a plain soft-grey background, with two coins lifted away from the top of the stack and floating just above it, clearly separated. The coins are completely blank with no markings.
math-t2w2-coins.alt: A stack of ten blank coins with two lifted away and floating above it

math-t2w3-powers.prompt: Three groups on a plain soft-grey background, left to right, getting dramatically larger: a single small cube, then a flat ten-by-ten square tray made of those same cubes, then a solid ten-by-ten-by-ten block of them. math-t2w3-powers.alt: One small cube, a ten-by-ten flat square of them, and a ten-by-ten-by-ten solid block of them

math-t2w4-gates.prompt: A straight track on a plain soft-grey background with four simple mechanical gates standing across it in a row, one behind the other. The first gate is swung open, the three behind it are still closed. A single ball waits on the track in front of the first gate.
math-t2w4-gates.alt: A ball on a track facing four gates in a row, the first open and the three behind it closed

math-t2w5-fan-meter.prompt: An ordinary white electric desk fan plugged into a plug-in energy monitor at a wall socket, photographed from the side. The monitor's small screen is blank and dark. Plain wall, daylight.
math-t2w5-fan-meter.alt: An electric desk fan plugged into a plug-in energy monitor with a blank screen

math-t2w6-containers.prompt: A row of clear measuring containers on a pale counter, largest to smallest: a one-litre jug, a half-litre bottle, a small clear cup, a tablespoon and a medical syringe. All empty and clean, all unmarked with no printed scales or numbers.
math-t2w6-containers.alt: A one-litre jug, a half-litre bottle, a small cup, a tablespoon and a syringe lined up by size

math-t2w6-pour.prompt: Water being poured in a clean stream from a clear cube-shaped container into a tall clear measuring jug on a pale counter, caught mid-pour. The jug is about a third full. No printed markings on either vessel.
math-t2w6-pour.alt: Water poured from a clear cube-shaped container into a tall jug, caught mid-pour

math-t2w7-cubes.prompt: On a plain soft-grey background, one tiny cube sits beside a large hollow open-topped cube that is exactly ten times wider, ten times deeper and ten times taller. A thin layer of the tiny cubes covers the floor of the large one, showing how many it would take.
math-t2w7-cubes.alt: A tiny cube beside a hollow cube ten times larger in every direction, with a layer of the tiny cubes on its floor

math-t2w8-tank.prompt: A blue plastic household water drum standing on a concrete ledge outside a house, with a brass tap fitted near the bottom and a plastic bucket on the ground beneath it catching a thin stream of water. Bright tropical daylight.
math-t2w8-tank.alt: A blue household water drum with a brass tap running into a bucket on the ground

math-t2w9-prisms.prompt: Four plain unmarked cardboard packages standing upright together on a pale surface: a tall rectangular box, a long triangular prism box, a cylindrical tube, and a cube. All plain brown card with no printing, labels or text of any kind.
math-t2w9-prisms.alt: A rectangular box, a triangular prism box, a cylindrical tube and a cube, all plain brown card

math-t2w10-aquarium.prompt: A large empty rectangular glass aquarium on a stand being filled with clear water from a hose, photographed from the side. The water is about a third of the way up and the fill line is clearly visible against the glass. Plain room behind.
math-t2w10-aquarium.alt: A rectangular glass aquarium being filled with water, about a third full

math-t2w11-desk.prompt: A school exam desk from above: a blank sheet of squared paper, a clear plastic ruler, a sharpened pencil, a simple calculator with a blank dark screen, and a few small wooden cubes. Nothing written anywhere.
math-t2w11-desk.alt: An exam desk with blank squared paper, a ruler, a pencil, a calculator and small wooden cubes

fil-t2w1-balikbayan.prompt: A large brown cardboard balikbayan box, taped shut with wide packing tape and criss-crossed with nylon cord, standing on the floor of a simple Filipino living room beside a rattan chair. Warm afternoon light through a window. No writing or labels on the box.
fil-t2w1-balikbayan.alt: A large taped and corded cardboard shipping box standing in a simple living room

fil-t2w2-pointing.prompt: Three hands against a plain pale background, each pointing in a different direction: the first pointing back at its own chest, the second pointing straight forward at the viewer, the third pointing away to one side. Only hands and forearms are visible, no faces.
fil-t2w2-pointing.alt: Three hands pointing: one back at itself, one forward at the viewer, one away to the side

fil-t2w3-okir.prompt: A dark hardwood panel carved in deep relief with flowing curved leaf-and-vine scrollwork in the Maranao okir tradition, photographed straight on in raking light so the carved depth and tool marks show clearly. Fills the frame.
fil-t2w3-okir.alt: A dark hardwood panel carved in deep relief with flowing curved leaf-and-vine scrollwork

fil-t2w4-chairs.prompt: A long row of identical empty white plastic monobloc chairs lined up across the polished floor of a covered barangay basketball court, photographed down the length of the row. Nobody is sitting in any of them. Bright daylight through open sides.
fil-t2w4-chairs.alt: A long row of identical empty white plastic chairs across a covered court

fil-t2w5-precolonial.prompt: A museum-style arrangement on dark cloth: a woven rattan basket, a plain earthenware clay pot, a coil of abaca rope, and a small tarnished bronze ornament. Soft directional light, no labels, no cards, no text.
fil-t2w5-precolonial.alt: A woven rattan basket, an earthenware pot, abaca rope and a small bronze ornament on dark cloth

fil-t2w6-palengke.prompt: A Filipino wet-market produce stall seen straight on, piled with contrasting goods: a mound of small round calamansi, long thin string beans, knobbly bitter gourd, smooth purple eggplants, and a bundle of rough brown coconuts. No price signs, no writing anywhere.
fil-t2w6-palengke.alt: A market stall piled with calamansi, string beans, bitter gourd, eggplants and coconuts

fil-t2w7-simbahan.prompt: The weathered stone facade of an old Spanish colonial church in the Philippines, photographed straight on: thick coral-stone walls, a heavy arched wooden door, carved pilasters and a squat bell tower to one side. Overcast daylight. No signage or text.
fil-t2w7-simbahan.alt: The weathered stone facade of an old Spanish colonial church with an arched wooden door and a bell tower

fil-t2w8-opposites.prompt: Two open upturned hands side by side against a plain pale background. The left hand holds a single white feather resting weightlessly on the palm. The right hand holds a dark rounded river stone that visibly presses into the skin. Only hands, no faces.
fil-t2w8-opposites.alt: One open hand holding a white feather and the other holding a heavy dark river stone

fil-t2w9-aspekto.prompt: Three close views of the same hand in a row against a plain background, showing one task at three stages: bare knuckles with a rolled boxing hand wrap lying beside them, the same hand half wrapped with the tape mid-wind, and the hand fully wrapped and finished. No faces.
fil-t2w9-aspekto.alt: The same hand shown three times: unwrapped with the tape beside it, half wrapped, and fully wrapped

fil-t2w9-hapon.prompt: A still arrangement on worn wooden floorboards in dim light: a battered leather suitcase with its catches closed, a small brass kerosene lamp with a sooty glass chimney, a dented tin canteen, and a folded coarse blanket. No text or markings.
fil-t2w9-hapon.alt: A battered leather suitcase, a brass kerosene lamp, a dented tin canteen and a folded blanket on wooden floorboards

fil-t2w10-dahandahan.prompt: Close view of two hands working a small screwdriver into one screw on the back plate of an opened electric fan motor housing, very deliberate and careful, with three removed screws lined up neatly on the bench beside it. Shallow depth of field, no faces.
fil-t2w10-dahandahan.alt: Hands carefully turning a screwdriver on an opened fan motor, with three removed screws lined up beside it

fil-t2w11-mesa.prompt: A quiet study desk from above: a closed plain notebook, two sharpened pencils, a worn eraser, and a glass of water, on a wooden tabletop in warm morning light. Nothing written, no labels, no text.
fil-t2w11-mesa.alt: A closed plain notebook, two pencils, an eraser and a glass of water on a wooden desk

eng-t2w1-finished.prompt: An empty dinner plate on a wooden table after a meal, with a used fork and spoon resting across it, a few crumbs and a smear of sauce left, and a drained glass beside it. Warm late light. Completely finished, nobody there.
eng-t2w1-finished.alt: An empty plate after a meal with used cutlery, crumbs and a drained glass

eng-t2w2-doors.alt: A tidy queue of identical figures through one doorway and the same number in total chaos through the other

eng-t2w3-takeapart.alt: A mechanical alarm clock taken apart with every component laid out in rows beside a small screwdriver

eng-t2w4-packed.prompt: A packed gym bag sitting by a front door at night, zipped shut, with a pair of training shoes placed neatly beside it, a water bottle standing ready and a jump rope coiled on top. Nobody is there. The door is closed.
eng-t2w4-packed.alt: A packed gym bag by a closed front door with shoes, a water bottle and a coiled jump rope ready

eng-t2w5-candles.prompt: Three candles standing in a row on a dark surface against a plain background. The left one is brand new and unlit with a clean white wick. eng-t2w5-candles.alt: Three candles in a row: new and unlit, burning and half melted, and burnt down to a cold stub

_never: NEVER generate an image that poses as a documentary photograph of a specific real place, artwork, artefact or person - the Angono Petroglyphs, the Spoliarium, Rizal. A generated picture of a named real thing is a false claim about the world, and CLAUDE.md says facts must be true. Generated photographs depict a TYPE (kamote, a kulintang, a sipa shuttle), never a named original. For a specific real artefact use tools/fetch-images.mjs to pull the real, credited photograph from Wikimedia instead.
